description: Reviewed non-alarmist scientific reason templates for Nutri-Score calculation components.

templates.format: Energy of {value} {unit} contributes {points} adverse point(s) out of 10.
templates.defaultText: Energy contributes points based on declared kJ per 100g or 100ml under the official threshold table.
templates.scope: General foods, fats/oils/nuts/seeds, and beverages energy points allocation.

templates.format: Total sugars of {value} {unit} contribute {points} adverse point(s) under the European reference algorithm.
templates.defaultText: Total sugars contribute points based on declared grams per 100g or 100ml under official threshold tables.
templates.scope: Adverse points allocation for declared total sugars.

templates.format: Saturated fatty acids of {value} {unit} contribute {points} adverse point(s) out of 10.
templates.defaultText: Saturated fatty acids contribute points based on declared grams per 100g or 100ml.
templates.scope: General food and beverage saturated fat component.

templates.format: Saturated fatty acids ratio to total lipids ({value}%) contributes {points} adverse point(s) out of 10.
templates.defaultText: For fats and oils, saturated fatty acids are evaluated as a ratio of total lipids (saturates / total fat * 100).
templates.scope: Fats, oils, nuts and seeds route ratio point allocation.

templates.format: Salt content of {value} {unit} contributes {points} adverse point(s) out of 20.
templates.defaultText: Salt contributes points based on declared salt content in grams per 100g or 100ml.
templates.scope: Adverse points allocation for salt across all calculation routes.

templates.format: Protein content of {value} {unit} contributes {points} favourable point(s).
templates.defaultText: Protein contributes favourable points, subject to conditional subtraction rules and red meat point caps.
templates.scope: Favourable protein points for general foods, fats, and beverages.

templates.format: Protein content of {value} {unit} in red meat is capped at {points} favourable point(s).
templates.defaultText: For red meat products, protein points are capped at a maximum of 2 points under official rules.
templates.scope: Red meat specific protein point cap.

templates.format: Dietary fibre content of {value} {unit} contributes {points} favourable point(s) out of 5.
templates.defaultText: Dietary fibre contributes favourable points based on declared grams per 100g or 100ml.
templates.scope: Favourable fibre points across all routes.

templates.format: Fruits, vegetables and legumes content of {value}% contributes {points} favourable point(s).
templates.defaultText: Eligible fruits, vegetables and legumes contribute favourable points when exceeding official percentage thresholds.
templates.scope: Favourable fruits, vegetables, and legumes component points.

templates.format: Presence of an included non-nutritive sweetener adds 4 adverse points in the beverage calculation route.
templates.defaultText: Under the updated beverage algorithm, the presence of non-nutritive sweeteners adds 4 adverse points.
templates.scope: Beverage reference scoring for included non-nutritive sweeteners; this is not a legal-authorisation assessment.
templates.sourceLocator: 2023 beverages report p. 27 Table 2 and p. 73 beverage points table; pinned method routes.beverage.adverseComponents.sweeteners

templates.format: Cheese route: favourable points (including protein) are subtracted without the 11-point adverse limit.
templates.defaultText: For cheeses, all favourable points (protein, fibre, FVL) are subtracted from adverse points regardless of total adverse score.
templates.scope: Cheese specific favourable component subtraction exception.

templates.format: Supported plain water is classified as Grade A automatically under the European reference algorithm.
templates.defaultText: A supported plain-water classification uses the water exception rather than a nutrient-point calculation.
templates.scope: Supported plain water only; zero energy alone does not establish this classification.
templates.sourceLocator: 2023 beverages report p. 75 Final Nutri-Score thresholds; pinned method routes.beverage.scoring.waterRule

templates.format: Protein earns {points} favourable point(s), but these points are not subtracted under the conditional protein rule.
templates.defaultText: The applicable reference route does not subtract protein points in this case.
templates.scope: General-food and fats/oils/nuts/seeds conditional protein subtraction only.
templates.sourceLocator: 2022 food report p. 132 section 1.3 and p. 135 section 2.4; pinned method routes.general.scoring.conditionalProteinRule and routes.fats_nuts_seeds.scoring.conditionalProteinRule

templates.format: Energy from saturated fatty acids of {value} {unit} contributes {points} adverse point(s).
templates.defaultText: For fats, oils, nuts and seeds, the energy component is calculated from saturated fatty acids, rather than total energy.
templates.scope: Fats/oils/nuts/seeds energy from saturates; derived kJ per 100g.
templates.sourceLocator: 2022 food report p. 133 Table 2.2 and its energy-from-saturates footnote; pinned method routes.fats_nuts_seeds.adverseComponents.energy
